# **Use AI to evaluate every applicant**

The reality is – you're being asked to do more with less.

Speak\_ is your customizable AI recruitment partner that reviews every resume and helps you **find the needle in the haystack**.

[Get started for free →](https://app.speak.careers/register)

or

[Book a Call](https://form.typeform.com/to/s5PH8WEH)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610196fe9487ed8942be1a6f/66f4553087868b2bb5c6ca9b_Container.svg)

## Recruiters face a lot of problems.   Speak\_ can help.

There's never enough time.

![small green arrow](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610196fe9487ed8942be1a6f/663a3e4411314ca91d75d698_arrow.svg)

Speak\_ evaluates candidates asynchronously, saving you hours of sifting through unsorted resumes looking for the good ones.

Resume review is prone to bias.

![small green arrow](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610196fe9487ed8942be1a6f/663a3e4411314ca91d75d698_arrow.svg)

You’ll remove the potential for unconscious bias by setting custom signals that teach our platform how to find the ideal candidate.

The resume pile is huge, but only a small percentage of them are qualified.

![small green arrow](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610196fe9487ed8942be1a6f/663a3e4411314ca91d75d698_arrow.svg)

Our technology will screen every resume using your custom signals and find the most qualified candidates more efficiently.

## **Find your needle in a world of haystacks.**

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610196fe9487ed8942be1a6f/66f4285770f4bd71e770fc5e_star-icon-svg.svg)

### Set custom signals

You know better than anyone how to find the best candidates. Now you can teach AI to review resumes just like you.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610196fe9487ed8942be1a6f/66f4287fe96d93287921fd01_checkbox-icon-svg.svg)

### Evaluate candidates async

At 90 seconds per resume, it takes a recruiter 25 hours to review 1000 resumes. With Speak\_, you can evaluate candidates while you sleep.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610196fe9487ed8942be1a6f/66f428a3dffccf815f4a6b76_insights-icon-svg.svg)

### Get in-depth insights

We'll tell you who's a match, who isn't, and why. See the highlights and lowlights of every candidate.

Accuracy matters

## **Find what you're really looking for**

Describe the skills, experiences, and qualities that you're looking for in candidates. Tell the AI how important they are. We'll look through your applicants and find the best fits.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610196fe9487ed8942be1a6f/66f4298714f7e047694155ac_set-signals-svg.svg)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610196fe9487ed8942be1a6f/66f45221c0914feb05c3fa6b_best-candidates-svg.svg)

Easy and efficient

## **Lots of resumes? Don't worry.**

We'll evaluate every candidate based on your custom criteria and put the best applicants at the top of the list.

Make better hires

## **Spend more time on what matters**

You'll save over 20 hours per 1000 resumes. Use that time however you'd like.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610196fe9487ed8942be1a6f/66f45282ec78561221e8105a_scoring-candidates-svg.svg)

## **What our customers say**

![photo of Wendy Sergot, HR Manager at Alpine Home Air](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610196fe9487ed8942be1a6f/66e89332a366f65d62c39c57_1517657031372.jpg)

### Wendy Sergot

HR Manager

_Alpine Home Air_

We received over 3,000 applicants for just one role, and **Speak\_ has worked really well.** The bulk disposition feature allows me to efficiently advance or disqualify candidates based on their scores -- a huge value add. Plus, I love the flexibility to add custom signals!

![Maeve Kievit, Head of People at Prepared Hero](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610196fe9487ed8942be1a6f/66e896a1d47724f7be094780_maeve%20kievit.jpg)

### Maeve Kievit

Head of People

_Prepared Hero_

We've been inundated with applications for so many roles, and it's been challenging to get through the volume to identify the candidates we actually want to speak to. **Speak\_ really shines** here by helping us get directly to the candidates that fit our criteria, **saving us so much time.**

![Kali Bell, Director of Talent Strategy at Evidence Action](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/610196fe9487ed8942be1a6f/66e8995d22a4361245ea2ece_kali%20bell.jpg)

### Kali Bell

Director, Talent Strategy

_Evidence Action_

**We love it.** I'm not sure if you're aware, but our ATS recently introduced a feature that scores resumes. However, it does no justice compared to what Speak\_ offers. **We much prefer Speak\_ because of its accuracy.**

## **Frequently asked questions**

Have questions? We've got answers. For everything else email us at support@speak.careers.

### How does Speak\_ work?

➕

Speak\_ uses AI to evaluate every applicant based on custom criteria (called "Signals") that you set.

### Which applicant tracking systems (ATS) are you integrated with?

➕

We're currently integrated with Ashby, Lever, Greenhouse, and Workable, with more integrations on the way.

### Can I use Speak\_ without an ATS?

➕

Yes, you can use Speak\_ without an ATS. Simply add a job, set signals, and drop in resumes.

### Where can I book a demo?

➕

We'd love to show you around! You can find an open time that works for you by clicking on [this calendar link](https://calendly.com/d/ck8m-28m-tb8/speak_).

### Do you have an affiliate program?

➕

Yes! [Sign up to become an affiliate](https://speak-affiliate.getrewardful.com/signup) and earn a commission for every customer who signs up through your referral link.
